dockerfile.description: Every Dockerfile here is a Jinja template whose base image is a SONiC container or a Debian image the version freeze owns. The one plain Dockerfile, docker-basic_router, starts from docker-base, a local image

customManagers.description: Docker in the image. The build appends ~$IMAGE_DISTRO, so the apt index's ~trixie suffix is stripped
containerd in the image, as for Docker
Rust toolchain in the trixie build container, and in the watchdog containers' builder stage, which install their own. Both move in one pull request

OpenTelemetry Collector (contrib) in docker-sonic-otel, one dependency per architecture. Renovate takes the new release's sha256 for each package and updates OTEL_SHA256 with OTEL_TAG, so the new hash is reviewed in the PR
FIPS Go for trixie. SONiC builds and publishes the package, so the preset lists it on the Dependency Dashboard only

packageRules.description: Renovate merges the updates the preset labels automerge: security updates below a major version, except patched modules. It merges on a later run, once every check on the head commit has passed, not only the required ones, and the renovate-approve app has approved the pull request. Reviewers are still assigned, so one that fails reaches them.
